$note: 遷移宮（2026-10-12）：天同.遷移。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 遷移宮 p.496–515。客死異鄉、異鄉染病、官非、冤獄、被盜、意外一類斷語不用；天月、天刑、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用；要睇廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 天同化祿，你出外不一定發財，但安定享福，遇事有人幫忙。
rules.en: Tian Tong in Abundance: travel brings comfort rather than money; things settle, and others help when needed.

rules.text: 天同化忌，你出門在外時多擔心、放不下。
rules.en: Tian Tong in Obstruction: when you are away from home, you worry a lot and find it hard to let go.

rules.text: 同宮有火星或鈴星，在外多挫折不安，往往功虧一簣，要費盡心力才扭轉得來。
rules.en: With Huo Xing or Ling Xing in the palace, there are setbacks away from home, often at the last step, and it takes real effort to turn things round.

rules.text: 天同在遷移宮，你出門在外一般是得福的。
rules.en: With Tian Tong in your Travel Palace, going out into the world generally brings you good fortune.
